Meet Safaya Hair Studio

About us

Safaya Hair Studio is a salon at 501 Swede St in Norristown, PA. The work centers on braiding, weaves and sew-ins, extensions, color, and keratin.

The menu also covers perms, permanent hair straightening, curly hair styling, and women's cuts. Fresha lists the studio as call to book.
